questions.task: Ikkita massivni spread bilan birlashtiring: [1,2] va [3,4].
Spread va Rest operatorlari bo'yicha qo'shimcha amaliy vazifa: kichik misol yozing.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: a=17, b=5; qo'shish, ayirish, ko'paytirish, qoldiq, daraja chiqaring.
questions.sample:
let a = 17, b = 5;
console.log(a + b, a - b, a * b, a % b, a ** 2);

questions.task: Spread va Rest operatorlari: x=10; x+=5; x*=2; x ni chiqaring.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: ++x va x++ farqini ikki log bilan ko'rsating (x=5).
Spread va Rest operatorlari: "5" + 3 va "5" - 3 natijalarini chiqaring.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: [10,20,30] yarating, push 40, length chiqaring.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: filter bilan juft sonlar.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: map bilan *2.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: reduce yig'indi.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: find bilan 10 dan kattasi.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: slice va splice farqini kichik misolda ko'rsating.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: talaba {ism, yosh, kurs} yarating va ism chiqaring.
questions.sample:
let talaba = { ism: "Dilshod", yosh: 20, kurs: 2 };
console.log(talaba.ism);

questions.task: Spread va Rest operatorlari: Object.keys va values chiqaring.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: destrukturatsiya {x,y} = point.
Spread va Rest operatorlari: spread bilan obyekt nusxa + yangi maydon.
